description: Intermediate semantic representation produced by GREETING-µ greeting.decompose. Carries gram evidence from raw prompt through GramStore → ELIZA-µ → SRAI-µ → π → XCFE without losing provenance. Every downstream micronaut receives this payload — not the raw string.
logged_by: Pattern.Log.dll at decompose, route, and each XCFE admission transition
word_domain_tree_ref_note: Set to data/word-domain-tree.json once a WDT instance is built. greeting.decompose uses the WDT to assign domain + pi_radius to each key and to prune excluded edges.
manifest_note: words.manifest.json Stage-1: corpus_provenance + pos_hint. keys.micronaut.json Stage-2: lane + authority + pi_routing_weight + routing_entropy. float.json: float32 precision contract. aiml.manifest.json: AIML lifecycle phase map + aiml:relation_verbs + match_grants_execution:false. mx2lm.manifest.json: MX2LM contract (nodes=meaning, relations=association, association_weight:pattern_strength_only, execution_authority:canonical_only) + WCR (Wc/Cc/Rc(Q)) candidate selection. scfml.manifest.json: SCFML branch semantics (SCFML_declares_XCFE_authorizes, MISS_not_CONTRADICTED, UNKNOWN_not_else, else_not_not, fact_authority:false_by_default). semantic-fields.manifest.json: ⟁KEY field membership and typed domain relations. tool.manifest.json: tool verb registry + InvocationValidationBoundary + tool:admission gate. tools.manifest.json: vector_match (embeddinggemma-2 / 256-dim) + field_query phase axes. relational.manifest.json: relational edge verbs + rendering_projection_only authority boundary + tensor-slot-law.

source_text.description: Original raw prompt, unmodified. Never normalised, lowercased, or stripped at this layer.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of source_text. Used for Pattern.Log.dll correlation across the pipeline.

session_id.description: Conversation session identifier. Binds this payload to a GramStore session context.

tokens.description: Ordered, offset-anchored tokens from the raw prompt. pos_hint is derived by Stage-1 manifest lookup (words.manifest.json) and Stage-2 keys lookup (keys.micronaut.json) in that priority order.
pos_hint_derivation_rules: social:       token has intent:salutation in words.manifest, or is in the 'greeting' alias chain (hello/hi/hey/yo/sup/howdy)
code_token:   token has intent:debugging or intent:code_generation in words.manifest, OR the token's derived ⟁KEY matches lane:CODE-µ in keys.micronaut.json (authority:XCFE_required)
operator:     token has a control:* entry in words.manifest (if/then/else/when/who/why/how/for/from/as/equals)
question_word: token is who/what/when/where/why/how, or has an ELIZA-1:QUESTION op in words.manifest
anaphor:      token is it/this/that/they/them/those/here/there, confirmed by words.manifest alias chain or heuristic surface match
noun:         token has Book(SUBJECT) or intent:syntax_role subject in words.manifest; fallback POS inference
verb:         token has Book(PREDICATE) or intent:syntax_role action in words.manifest; fallback POS inference
unknown:      no manifest match and POS inference inconclusive
PRIORITY: social > code_token > operator > question_word > anaphor > noun/verb > unknown

item.pos_hint: string — noun | verb | question_word | social | anaphor | code_token | operator | unknown
item.is_stopword: bool — true if token contributes no semantic weight alone

grams.description: N-gram spans extracted at lengths 1–4. corpus_provenance is assigned by Stage-1 manifest lookup (words.manifest.json) with Stage-2 keys.micronaut.json for cfpc source confirmation. Rules apply in priority order — first match wins.
corpus_provenance_derivation_rules: aiml:        (a) gram surface matches a triple-form dispatch prefix in words.manifest (KEYWORD: / keyword: / @keyword) → named micronaut dispatch; OR (b) gram matches an AIML structural keyword in aiml.manifest.json (aiml:pattern / aiml:wildcard / aiml:topic / aiml:that / aiml:graph / aiml:relation / aiml:relation_verbs); OR (c) gram matches a reasoning-board.aiml pattern head (WHAT_IS_* / COMPARE_*_AND_* / WHY_DOES_*) — these carry authority:data_only and match_grants_execution:false from aiml.manifest.json
code_corpus: gram has intent:debugging or intent:code_generation in words.manifest, OR the gram's first token maps to lane:CODE-µ in keys.micronaut.json
eliza:       gram has at least one ELIZA-1:* operator ref (ELIZA-1:CAUSE/EVIDENCE/STATE/SEQUENCE/CONTRAST/etc.) in words.manifest after alias expansion

cfpc:        gram matches entries in cfpc-wildcards.gml or cfpc-questions.gml (listed in keys.micronaut.json ⟁POP:FIELD_CONTEXT.graph); also applies when the gram's normalized form matches a known CFPC question template
none:        gram has no entry in words.manifest after alias expansion, and no match in keys.micronaut.json
PRIORITY: aiml > code_corpus > eliza > cfpc > none

item.corpus_provenance: string — aiml | eliza | cfpc | code_corpus | none
item.semantic_role: string — question_operator | subject | relation | social | anaphor | mechanism | code_signal | modifier | unknown

keys.description: Canonical ⟁KEY identifiers derived from grams. Keys are the nodes in the word-key field graph. Stage-2 keys.micronaut.json lookup populates lane, key_authority, pi_routing_weight, and routing_entropy. Stage-3 WDT lookup populates domain and pi_radius.

item.gram_text: string — gram this key was derived from
item.graph_relation: string — structural relations: DEFINE | EXPLAIN | CODE | COMPARE | PURPOSE | MECHANISM | GREETING | REFERS_TO | TARGET | ESCALATE | EXECUTE | MODIFY | UNKNOWN — AIML relation verbs (from aiml.manifest.json, all effect:read commit:none): RELATED_TO | DEPENDS_ON | SUPPORTS | DELEGATES_TO | HAS_PROPERTY | POSSESSES | VALUE_OF | IMPORTS | CALLS | EXPOSES — relational edge verbs (from relational.manifest.json relational:edge-verbs, all rendering_projection_only not_semantic_truth not_Xul_persistence): CALL | COMPOSE | DELEGATE | EVAL | INFORMS | RELATE
item.lane: string? — typed pipeline lane from keys.micronaut.json: lane:key-µ | lane:MX2LM-µ | lane:KUHUL-PI | lane:CODE-µ | null if no match
item.key_authority: string? — authority constraint from keys.micronaut.json entry: data_only | proposal_only | candidate_only | retrieval_only | candidate_ranking_only | XCFE_required | null if no match. lane:CODE-µ forces XCFE_required.
item.pi_routing_weight: float32? range [0.0,1.0] — formula: 1.0 - hub_cost (Sek-phase, kernel: pi-routing-weight.cl). From lane:KUHUL-PI in keys.micronaut.json. DATA_ONLY: semantic_authority:false, xcfe_admission_required:true. NaN or Inf → treat as null, do not propagate as candidate. null if lane != KUHUL-PI.
item.routing_entropy: float32? range [0.0,1.0] — formula: -sum(p*log2(p))/log2(N) (Ch'en entropy_norm). From lane:KUHUL-PI. Must satisfy ENTROPY_BOUNDS at Ch'en before routing proposal advances to Xul. NaN or Inf → treat as null. null if lane != KUHUL-PI.
item.wcr_score: float32? range [0.0,1.0] — WCR candidate selection score (Wc=word cost, Cc=contextual cost, Rc(Q)=relation-conditioned query; Phase:Yax) from mx2lm:wcr. From lane:MX2LM-µ. association_weight:pattern_strength_only — this is co-occurrence strength, NOT semantic truth. execution_authority:canonical_only: a high wcr_score does NOT authorise execution. NaN or Inf → treat as null. null if lane != MX2LM-µ.
item.domain: string? — WDT domain node id this key matched (null if no WDT match or WDT unavailable)

pi_radius.description: Inherited from the WDT node. Encodes geometric position on the K'UHUL π-wheel.
pi_radius.depth: int 0–10 — hierarchy depth in the domain tree
pi_radius.domain: string — domain label at this radius
pi_radius.relation: string — relation type at this radius
pi_radius.depth_prior: float32 0.0–1.0 — depth-based prior; NOT a calibrated confidence score. NaN or Inf → treat as null per float.json authority boundary.

item.wdt_excludes: array of string? — domain ids this node excludes (from WDT node.excludes[]); used to prune false edges

edges.description: Typed directed edges in the word-key field graph. Edges are EVIDENCE, not authorisation. An edge with evidence_type=vector is a similarity candidate — it does not establish that the relationship is valid or executable. Edges sourced from WDT associated[] carry evidence_type=symbolic. Edges between two keys where one node's wdt_excludes contains the other's domain are silently pruned during decompose and must not appear here.

item.wdt_source: string? — 'associated' if this edge was produced from WDT node.associated[]; null otherwise

intent_candidates.description: Possible user goals identified by gram analysis and intent-graph traversal. Ordered by confidence descending.

item.operator: string — GREETING_ONLY | KNOWLEDGE_QUERY | RELATIONSHIP_QUERY | ACTION_REQUEST | OPINION_REQUEST | CODE_REQUEST | TASK_REQUEST
item.primary_key: string — key.id of the main subject or target
item.source: string — aiml_match | cfpc | intent_graph | code_signal | heuristic

gap_type.description: CFPC gap classification result. Set by cfpc_gap_classify fold. Null until that fold runs.

bindings.description: Wildcard captures, entity resolutions, and anaphoric bindings accumulated during gram analysis.
bindings.wildcards: array of { pattern: string, capture: string }
bindings.entities: array of { key_id: string, type: string }
bindings.context_refs: array of { from_key: string, resolves_to: string — key_id or 'unresolved' }. Entries where resolves_to='unresolved' and the source gram contains {@if}/{@then}/{@else} are SCFML branch markers — apply MISS_not_CONTRADICTED, UNKNOWN_not_else, else_not_not (from scfml.manifest.json). fact_authority:false_by_default on all SCFML-derived bindings.

unresolved.description: Tokens or references that could not be resolved at decompose time. Downstream micronauts must handle or escalate these.

item.reason: string — anaphoric_reference | unknown_entity | ambiguous_operator | code_fragment | out_of_vocabulary

routing.description: Routing decision populated by greeting.route (Yax-phase). Null fields until route runs. Routing proposal is xcfe_required — XCFE must admit before any downstream micronaut receives the turn.
routing.primary_target: string? — micronaut id (e.g. ELIZA-µ, CODE-µ, REASON-µ)
routing.secondary_targets: array of string — ordered additional micronauts in the escalation chain
routing.log_ref: string? — Pattern.Log.dll record id for this routing decision

provenance.phase: string — phase at which this payload was produced

invariants: Every edge.from and edge.to MUST reference a key.id present in keys[].
Every intent_candidates[].primary_key MUST reference a key.id present in keys[].
routing.primary_target is null until greeting.route executes — no micronaut may be dispatched on a null routing.
routing.xcfe_status must be 'admitted' before any entry in escalation_path receives the turn.
Edges with evidence_type='vector' are ranking evidence only — not proof that the relationship is semantically valid or executable.
code_signal in intent_candidates requires at least one token with pos_hint='code_token' OR backtick/indented block detection in source_text.
unresolved entries must be preserved through all pipeline stages until explicitly resolved by a downstream micronaut — they may not be silently dropped.
The payload is immutable after Ch'en verification. Downstream micronauts annotate their own outputs; they do not rewrite the WordKeyField in place.
Pattern.Log.dll records are append-only. source_hash is the correlation key across all log entries for a single prompt.
If keys[].domain is non-null, keys[].pi_radius MUST be populated from the matching WDT node and depth_prior_is_calibrated_confidence MUST be false — depth_prior is a prior, not a scored prediction.

Edges between two keys where one key's wdt_excludes contains the other key's domain MUST be pruned during greeting.decompose. Excluded edges must not appear in edges[] — they are silently dropped, never promoted or logged as candidates.

keys[].pi_routing_weight and keys[].routing_entropy MUST be float32 in [0.0, 1.0] when non-null. NaN or Inf values MUST be treated as null and must not propagate as routing candidates (per float.json float:authority-boundary).

keys[].pi_routing_weight confers no semantic authority: match_grants_execution:false, xcfe_admission_required:true. A high pi_routing_weight is a routing signal — not proof that the target is semantically correct or execution-authorised.

keys[].routing_entropy (entropy_norm) must satisfy ENTROPY_BOUNDS at Ch'en before the routing proposal advances to Xul. A routing proposal with routing_entropy outside [0.0, 1.0] or with NaN/Inf must be rejected at Ch'en verification.

edges[] with graph_relation in the AIML relation verb set (RELATED_TO / DEPENDS_ON / SUPPORTS / DELEGATES_TO / HAS_PROPERTY / POSSESSES / VALUE_OF / IMPORTS / CALLS / EXPOSES) carry effect:read and commit:none — they are read-only relational evidence. match_grants_execution:false applies to all reasoning-board.aiml pattern-sourced edges regardless of relation type.
mx2lm:nodes=meaning — MX2LM nodes ARE meaning, not pointers to meaning. Edges built on MX2LM nodes are associative only; they cannot be resolved into execution authority or semantic truth.
mx2lm:relations=association — MX2LM relations are association only, never causation, implication, or execution authority. relation_confidence is an earned signal from co-occurrence — not a proof.

mx2lm:association_weight:pattern_strength_only — keys[].wcr_score and any MX2LM-sourced edge weight measure pattern co-occurrence strength. They must not be used as semantic truth signals or as routing authority above a data_only boundary.

mx2lm:execution_authority:canonical_only — MX2LM cannot execute, cannot authorise dispatch, and cannot override XCFE. Only canonical micronauts with xcfe_gated authority can execute. A wcr_score near 1.0 does not change this.

SCFML: unresolved bindings.context_refs entries where the source gram contains {@if}/{@then}/{@else} are SCFML branch markers. MISS_not_CONTRADICTED: an unresolved SCFML branch is a MISS, never a contradiction. UNKNOWN_not_else: unresolved branches resolve to UNKNOWN, not to any else branch. else_not_not: an else branch is a fallback, not a logical negation of the if condition. fact_authority:false_by_default: no SCFML-derived binding carries fact authority until XCFE authorises it.

tool:admission — tool dispatch candidates in intent_candidates carry semantic_commit:false and audit:jrom_required. Tool admission requires BOTH a matching intent_key (from words.manifest.json) AND a registered_verb (from tool.manifest.json). Neither alone is sufficient: an intent_key without a registered_verb is not admissible; a registered_verb without an intent_key is not admissible. InvocationValidationBoundary must be satisfied before any tool verb is promoted from candidate to dispatch.

relational:rendering_projection_only — edges[] with graph_relation in {CALL, COMPOSE, DELEGATE, EVAL, INFORMS, RELATE} are rendering projections only. They are not_semantic_truth: a relational edge does not assert that the relationship is semantically valid. They are not_Xul_persistence: relational edges must not be persisted to Xul-layer storage as facts. They carry execution_plan_projection_only semantics — an edge describes a projected execution shape, not an authorised execution plan.

vector similarity (VECTOR-µ Wo): edges (vector evidence_type) — appended by VECTOR-µ, not GREETING-µ
